sqlMap.select: SELECT LANGUAGE, DESCRIPTION, '' CONTENT FROM SY_LANGUAGE WHERE ACTIVITY = 1

SELECT SY_LANGUAGE.LANGUAGE, SY_LANGUAGE.DESCRIPTION, SY_GLOBAL_NAME.SEQ, SY_GLOBAL_NAME.NO, SY_GLOBAL_NAME.CONTENT FROM SY_LANGUAGE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME WHERE SY_LANGUAGE.LANGUAGE = SY_GLOBAL_NAME.LANGUAGE(+) AND SY_LANGUAGE.ACTIVITY = 1
SY_GLOBAL_NAME.NO(+) = #NO:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY SY_GLOBAL_NAME.NO
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO SY_GLOBAL_NAME (SEQ, NO, LANGUAGE, CONTENT, CREATED_BY, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES (SY_GLOBAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #NO:VARCHAR#, #LANGUAGE:VARCHAR#, #CONTENT:VARCHAR#, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#, SYSDATE )
